current_status: Gaze360 and four-category EMOTIC are available as opt-in CPU research modules; default modules unchanged; no scoring or adaptive follow-up input; no automatic reanalysis of existing sessions.
scope: Local consented simulation and noncommercial method research; observed_only; no scoring or adaptive branching inputs

gaze.calibration: not calibrated; explicit frame-size camera intrinsics estimate passed to OpenFace; no screen point or attention inference
gaze.geometry: 68 source 2D landmarks and official 50 mm ray projection from pupil-ring 3D points and gaze vectors; max 180 geometry windows per answer; no interpolation

expression.license: README declares Apache-2.0; root Apache-2.0 text retained; directory LICENSE link is missing upstream
expression.interpretation: model classification of apparent expression; not inner state

audio.implementation: WebRTC VAD mode2 + librosa pYIN + deterministic RMS

selection_rationale.AU-Net: Official pinned network/backbone/cross_model now run on CPU as explicitly selected research module au_net. Default OpenFace stays unchanged. YuNet preprocessing differs from upstream face_alignment; no equivalence or validity claim.
selection_rationale.Gaze360: Official pinned network with a pinned community-preserved checkpoint now runs on CPU as opt-in gaze360. Original endpoint remains 403; no author checksum proves byte identity. YuNet head preprocessing differs from original AlphaPose; single frontal face subset, no full-360-degree or attention claim.
selection_rationale.OpenFace3: Official issues #9 and #12 leave AU output mapping and gaze coordinates unresolved; use documented OpenFace2 output instead.
selection_rationale.legacy_keras: Not used; source/label/training license provenance weaker than official OpenCV alternative.
selection_rationale.EMOTIC: Opt-in emotic uses the officially linked Tandon third-party PyTorch implementation with community-preserved compatible weights. Four original category rows only: Anger, Happiness, Sadness, Surprise; continuous head removed before inference. Context-assisted perceived-emotion research labels, not a facial-only classifier or psychological measurement; no latent-state mapping or composite potential score.

specified_model_local_audit_20261025.scope: current workspace models, source and related asset records; no whole-disk scan
specified_model_local_audit_20261025.AU-Net: No locally usable AU-Net repository, configured predictor checkpoint or 2dfan2 backbone located; the older rationale refers to official availability, not a verified local inference setup.
specified_model_local_audit_20261025.Gaze360: No locally usable Gaze360 source, model checkpoint or seven-frame inference pipeline located.
specified_model_local_audit_20261025.action: Historical initial local inventory; superseded for AU-Net by original_au_net_execution_proof and optional_choices.au_net, and for Gaze360 by gaze360_emotic_execution_proof and optional_choices.gaze360. Original Gaze360 endpoint remains unavailable; community source limitation retained.

validation_limits: One repository English sample verifies real engineering inference, not Chinese-domain criterion validity.
No human reference annotations yet; no accuracy/F1/ICC claims for this project.
5 fps sampling is not microexpression capture.
AU whole-clip normalization and pYIN Viterbi use offline future context.
Gaze360 and EMOTIC preserved community checkpoints are pinned and hashed; unavailable originals and missing author checksums prevent independent byte-identity confirmation.
Gaze360 YuNet head crops and EMOTIC MobileNet-SSD person crops differ from upstream AlphaPose and YOLOv3 preprocessing; no original-paper performance reproduction claim.
Single-person scene only. Multiple faces or persons invalidate the observation; this is not multi-person interview tracking or identity recognition.
Gaze360 uses three future frames. EMOTIC frozen-image backmarking records later last_input_ms. Neither can be represented as evidence known before the used inputs arrived.
Four EMOTIC values are unbounded linear scores with checkpoint validation thresholds, not probabilities, intensity or psychological scales; no VAD or other 22 category values are serialized.

au_net.units: 15 sigmoid activation scores 0..1 and raw logits; not OpenFace 0..5 intensity or calibrated probabilities
au_net.preprocessing_difference: YuNet bbox/five points replace upstream face_alignment SFD/68 points

gaze360.input: Seven RGB head crops 224x224 at 8 Hz nearest native frames; no duplicated, padded or interpolated boundary frames
gaze360.units: 3D Cartesian direction, yaw/pitch radians, learned symmetric angular interval half-widths in radians; not calibrated probability or screen gaze point
gaze360.preprocessing_difference: YuNet frontal face-expanded head region replaces original AlphaPose head crop; full 360-degree ability not validated
gaze360.capture_contract: Native capture.at_ms and duration_ms with original frame dimensions and head xywh; seven input_captures and actual input_frame_times_ms retained
gaze360.origin_limitation: Official endpoint remains 403. Community download script names original URL; no author checksum establishes identical origin.

emotic.implementation: Third-party PyTorch implementation linked by official rkosti/emotic; not original Lua checkpoint
emotic.input: Whole RGB context 224x224 plus actual detected person RGB crop 128x128 with upstream normalization
emotic.units: Unbounded raw linear scores, matching validation thresholds and strict score-above-threshold labels; not probabilities or intensity
emotic.output_policy: Extract four original category-head rows and remove continuous head before inference; exact four-label allowlist on public serialization; no other 22 categories or VAD values in logs, API, persistence, summaries or reports
emotic.preprocessing_difference: Fixed MobileNet-SSD person detection replaces upstream YOLOv3; exactly one detected person plus shared YuNet multi-face rejection; no full-body visibility guarantee
emotic.capture_contract: Same native capture.at_ms and duration_ms for person xywh and whole context xywh, in original frame dimensions
emotic.origin_limitation: Original Tandon Drive returned 404; maintainer acknowledged possible deletion. Pinned community weights cannot be byte-compared to unavailable original release; no author checksum.
